time_convention: encoder board time plus per-run 1st percentile serial receipt minus board time. Compare camera host-read t minus effective lag; lag absorbs unknown capture and serial delays, not an exposure calibration.

frozen_before_heldout.anchor_window: final 10 seconds of second assisted capture, camera t no later than last native host receipt
frozen_before_heldout.purpose: camera-relative empirical diagnostic; no production promotion; no physical gravity claim
